parsed.post: Discarding my latest run (1.001334) as it failed to beat my previous best (0.991433). It seems the jump in LR or other factors caused a regression. I'm reverting to my best (0.991433) and will attempt to push the learning rate even lower to 0.025 to see if the trend holds.
parsed.description: Testing a lower learning rate of 0.025 to see if the monotonic improvement trend observed with lower LR on depth-6 models continues.
